response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS diff_above_avg FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY diff_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
